text: この　いみが　わかるか？

patterns.name: 〜がわかる
patterns.explanation: With わかる the thing that is understood takes が, not を. いみが　わかる = 'understand the meaning'.

patterns.name: 〜か
patterns.explanation: か at the end turns the line into a question; after a plain verb it sounds blunt and rough. わかるか = 'do you get it?'.
